title: Design System: Poke Monopoly Rules Helper

display.purpose: Header wordmark, 20px/700. Pixelify is limited to display UI; nameplates and menu headings use 14px/600, Ask uses 16px/600, and the index title uses 20px/600.

body.purpose: Rule sentences, explanations, questions and menu items at 16px; keep paragraphs at most 64ch.

mono.purpose: Citation numbers such as §4.1 L143 and line spans at 14px/500, with tabular numerals.

verdict.purpose: The first sentence of a cited answer at 20px/600; conflict answers have no verdict.

empty-title.purpose: The same welcome greeting at 32px/600 from 1024px; no other rule text uses this size.

label.purpose: Text-named answer-state tab at 14px/700. Nameplates use Pixelify 14px/600 with 0.04em tracking; citation tags use mono 14px/500.

meta.purpose: 12px mono model and token counts. Credits are also at least 12px, in the body face.

shadows.name: header-hinge
shadows.purpose: Light shell hinge below the header; the CSS uses shell-deep, which becomes #5E0716 in dark mode. No screen shadows.

shadows.name: dock-hinge
shadows.purpose: Light shell hinge above the dock; the CSS uses shell-deep, which becomes #5E0716 in dark mode. No screen shadows.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: New message enters from translateY(4px), opacity .5. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: shake
motion.purpose: Poké Ball tilts -14deg at 11%, +12deg at 33%, -10deg at 55%; neutral at 0%, 22%, 44%, 66.7%, 100%. Three tilts during 1.2s, then .6s rest; origin 50% 85%. Only without reduced motion.

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: Streaming CSS triangle opacity changes from 1 to 0. Only without reduced motion.

motion.name: menu-cursor
motion.purpose: CSS triangle opacity and transform: translateX(-4px) to 0. Disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: index-outline
motion.purpose: Selected source-entry outline-color and current section heading color transition. Disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No arrive, shake or blink animation is applied; all elements and pseudo-elements have transition-duration: 0s !important. State text carries everything.

breakpoints.name: minimum
breakpoints.purpose: Documented small-screen baseline, not an explicit CSS media query. Below 768px: 56px compact header, 40px portrait above-left, 16px thread gutters, stacked conflict rules, 48px Ask and field, 72px dock; help text remains accessible but visually hidden.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Inset screen with 15px vertical/16px horizontal margins, 3px shell-deep border and 12px radius; thread padding 32px 24px 24px; 48px side portraits; two-column conflicts; desktop header and 56px Ask/field, visible help. Index remains a full sheet through 1023px.

breakpoints.name: index-panel
breakpoints.purpose: Open index becomes a 400px right column; Back to chat gives way to the close button. Welcome greeting becomes 32px/1.1. Below this, the full-sheet index makes header, chat and dock inert and restores opener focus on close.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Documented wide viewport, not an additional CSS media query. Thread and composer stay capped at 720px, dialogue boxes at 640px and question bubbles at min(520px,88%); the open index stays 400px.

components.name: Gen-1 dialogue box
components.description: Guide replies carry a double border, a RULE GUIDE nameplate and a text-named state tab; mobile padding is 14px 16px.
components.html:
Rule guideFrom the rulebook

Each player starts with 20 coins.

The starting kit is listed in the rulebook.
components.css: .ds-dialogue{position:relative;margin-top:28px;max-width:640px;padding:16px 20px;border:6px double var(--ink,#1A1C22);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#FFFFFF);color:var(--ink,#1A1C22);font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}.ds-dialogue-head{position:absolute;left:10px;bottom:calc(100% + 6px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4}.ds-dialogue-name{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;background:var(--ink,#1A1C22);color:var(--surface,#FFFFFF);font-family:"Pixelify Sans", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}.ds-dialogue-state{padding:2px 10px 4px;border:2px solid #1F6B45;border-bottom:0;border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;background:#E3F3EA;color:#1F6B45;font-weight:700}.ds-verdict{margin:0;max-width:64ch;font-size:20px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:600}.ds-rule{margin:12px 0 0;max-width:64ch}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-dialogue{padding:14px 16px}}

components.name: Rule guide nameplate
components.description: A tab on the dialogue box edge; uppercase tracking belongs only to this Pixelify nameplate.

components.name: Answer state tabs
components.description: Five portrait-backed states always name their meaning in text; no state relies on color alone.
components.html: From the rulebookNot in the rulebookRules conflictCan’t help with thatNo answer this time
components.css: .ds-states{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.ds-state{padding:2px 10px 4px;border:2px solid var(--ds-state-ink);border-bottom:0;border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;background:var(--ds-state-ground);color:var(--ds-state-ink);font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:700}.ds-cited{--ds-state-ink:#1F6B45;--ds-state-ground:#E3F3EA}.ds-uncovered{--ds-state-ink:#7A4E00;--ds-state-ground:#FFF1CC}.ds-conflict{--ds-state-ink:#5B3A8C;--ds-state-ground:#EEE6F8}.ds-blocked{--ds-state-ink:#3E4A5C;--ds-state-ground:#E4E8EE}.ds-failed{--ds-state-ink:#A3152B;--ds-state-ground:#FDE7EA}

components.name: Rulebook index tag
components.description: The mono tag is identical in the answer and the index. Its pseudo-element extends the inline hit area to at least 44px.
components.html: <button class="ds-citation ds-focus" type="button" aria-label="Open section 4.1, line 143">§4.1 L143</button>
components.css: .ds-citation{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--lens,#1F5FBF);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface,#FFFFFF);color:var(--lens,#1F5FBF);font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out}.ds-citation::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-11px -3px}.ds-citation:hover{background:var(--lens-tint,#E6EEFA)}.ds-focus:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lens,#1F5FBF);outline-offset:2px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-citation{transition:none}}

components.name: Your question bubble
components.description: Questions align right, with a small bottom-right tail corner; maximum width is min(520px, 88%).
components.html: How many coins do I start with?
components.css: .ds-you{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end}.ds-question{margin:0;max-width:min(520px,88%);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:12px 12px 4px 12px;background:var(--user,#2B2F3A);color:var(--on-user,#FFFFFF);font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

components.name: Ask button
components.description: The yellow primary action is 56px square, 48px on mobile; includes hover, pressed and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-ask-demo{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px;background:var(--shell,#C8102E)}.ds-ask{width:56px;height:56px;padding:0;border:2px solid #1A1C22;border-radius:28px;background:var(--go,#FFCB05);color:var(--go-ink,#1A1C22);font-family:"Pixelify Sans", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 120ms ease-out,background-color 120ms ease-out}.ds-ask:hover:not(:disabled){background:#FFD83D}.ds-ask:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-ask:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--on-shell,#FFFFFF);outline-offset:2px}.ds-ask:disabled{background:#E8D27A;color:#7A4E00;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-ask{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:24px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-ask{transition:none}}

components.name: Message field
components.description: Only the field and Ask occupy the message bar. The field grows to 160px; Enter asks and Shift+Enter adds a line.
components.css: .ds-field-shell{padding:12px;background:var(--shell,#C8102E)}.ds-field-label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}.ds-field{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:56px;max-height:160px;resize:none;padding:14px 16px;border:2px solid var(--shell-deep,#8E0C21);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface,#FFFFFF);color:var(--ink,#1A1C22);font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.45;caret-color:var(--accent,#C8102E)}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--ink-muted,#4B5160);opacity:1}.ds-field:disabled{color:var(--ink-muted,#4B5160)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--on-shell,#FFFFFF);outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-field{min-height:48px;padding:11px 14px}}

components.name: Battle-menu question row
components.description: Borderless 44px rows with a CSS triangle cursor. The app moves focus with ↑/↓, Home and End; Enter asks.
components.css: .ds-menu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.ds-menu-item{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:10px 8px 10px 30px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:none;color:var(--ink,#1A1C22);text-align:left;font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer}.ds-menu-item::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:10px;top:50%;border-style:solid;border-width:6px 0 6px 9px;border-color:transparent transparent transparent var(--lens,#1F5FBF);opacity:0;transform:translate(-4px,-50%);transition:opacity 120ms ease-out,transform 120ms ease-out}.ds-menu-item:is(:hover,:focus):not(:disabled)::before,.ds-menu:not(:hover,:focus-within)>li:first-child>.ds-menu-item:not(:disabled)::before{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,-50%)}.ds-menu:hover .ds-menu-item:not(:hover)::before{opacity:0;transform:translate(-4px,-50%)}.ds-menu-item:hover:not(:disabled){color:var(--lens,#1F5FBF)}.ds-menu-item:disabled{color:var(--ink-muted,#4B5160);cursor:not-allowed}.ds-focus:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lens,#1F5FBF);outline-offset:2px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-menu-item::before{transition:none}}

components.name: Shell button
components.description: Rulebook and Clear live in the header, away from Ask. Clear uses the quiet borderless variant.
components.css: .ds-shell-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:12px;background:var(--shell,#C8102E)}.ds-shell-button{min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:2px solid var(--on-shell-muted,#FFE3E7);border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--on-shell,#FFFFFF);font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out}.ds-shell-button:hover:not(:disabled),.ds-shell-button[aria-expanded="true"]{background:var(--shell-deep,#8E0C21)}.ds-shell-button[aria-expanded="true"]{border-color:var(--on-shell,#FFFFFF)}.ds-shell-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--on-shell,#FFFFFF);outline-offset:2px}.ds-shell-quiet{border-color:transparent}.ds-shell-quiet:disabled{color:var(--on-shell-muted,#FFE3E7);cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-shell-button{padding:0 10px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-shell-button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A handheld Pokédex you ask about Poke Monopoly's rules. The red device frames a calm screen; the rule guide answers in Gen-1 dialogue boxes, and every rule it quotes carries the same number as its entry in the rulebook index, so a player (or an examiner watching the demo) sees at a glance what the rulebook backs and what it doesn't.

Direction: Retro-futurism / Y2K, adapted to the late-1990s Pokémon handheld: molded Pokédex-red plastic instead of chrome, a pale Game Boy LCD screen instead of neon on black, pixel display type only for nameplates and menus, and a hyperlegible face for every rule sentence. No gradients, glows or chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Chat (signature): playful device frame, calm readable screen, medium density. The newest answer's verdict line leads.
Rulebook index (drawer): denser reference, a Pokédex list. The search field and the selected entry lead.
**Gen-1 dialogue box** for every guide reply, with the "RULE GUIDE" nameplate and a blinking ▼ at bottom-right while text streams.
**▸ menu** for the welcome starters and the "Ask next" follow-ups, like the battle menu: ↑/↓ moves the cursor inside it, Enter asks.
every quoted rule carries a `§4.1 L143` mono tag that matches its Rulebook index entry exactly, so the source is one tap and one glance away.

rules.name: Quiet screen
rules.body: Pokédex red owns the frame (header and dock, about 30% of the viewport); the screen stays quiet so rule text reads.

rules.name: Text-named states
rules.body: Status colors map to the app's real answer states. Each has a portrait, a label and a color; color is never the only signal.

rules.name: Readable rules
rules.body: Display: **Pixelify Sans** 600/700 (OFL). Only the wordmark, the speaker nameplate on each box, menu headings, the Ask label and the index title. Never rule text.

rules.name: Sentence case
rules.body: Max line length 64ch. Sentence case everywhere; uppercase only in the 14px Pixelify nameplate (the games' convention), letter-spacing 0.04em.

rules.name: Shell-only depth
rules.body: Shadows: none on the screen. Shell only: header `box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #8E0C21`; dock `box-shadow: 0 -3px 0 #8E0C21`.

dos: All fonts are self-hosted as woff2 in `web/fonts/` with their OFL.txt; the page makes no third-party requests.
Only the thread scrolls; header and dock stay fixed; the newest message stays in view unless the user scrolled up.
Tap targets at least 44px; mobile body text at least 16px.

Realistic content: use real rulebook facts in examples and mockups, such as "Each player starts with 20 coins" (§4.1 L143), "one human against 1–3 AI opponents" (§1 L27), "Passing Start pays 5 coins" (§4.1 L145), and the Price Shield conflict (§4.6 L250–251 vs §A L760–765).
donts: Cards nested in cards (quote cards inside the reply bubble).
Identical stacked cards (the four labeled starter boxes).
One pill shape for three meanings (state stamps, citations and follow-ups were all 999px pills).
Bounce-like easing on the Poké Ball wobble (detector warning).
A system font with no type contrast.
Gray text on white below 4.5:1 ("Clear conversation", `#8d9aa1`, 2.89:1).
Meta text that contradicts itself ("Claude · claude-haiku-5-5 · Local guardrail · no Claude request made").
Purple or blue gradients, glows, chrome and neon.
Emoji or Unicode glyphs used as icons.
Uppercase tracked labels beyond the nameplate.
The same radius or shadow on everything; everything centred.
Pixel type for any sentence a player must read.
Turning the chat into a game board or adding game-state controls.
Jokes in errors or refusals (the game's own UI rule: plain tone).
